## v0.5.48: Reliable Activation and Quieter Memory Tasks / 更可靠的激活与更安静的记忆任务

- Fix optional strategy activation after duplicate bundle installation and support symbol-based Cordis root metadata (#675, #676).
- Archive finished internal task shells, isolate automatic idle reviews and refresh original internal titles when users continue a task (#667, #671).
- Support skill evolution with bounded supporting files and an optional 3D Memory Spaces overview; retain the default 2D view (#668, #669).
- Show the existing 64 KiB skill write limit during review and give oversized drafts a size-aware retry and actionable manual-save feedback (#677).
- Document and verify isolated Hindsight bank writes (#672).

- 修复重复 bundle 导致可选策略启用后立即销毁，并兼容 Symbol 形式的 Cordis 根上下文元数据（#675、#676）。
- 归档已完成的内部任务会话，隔离自动空闲整理，并在用户接续任务时刷新原始内部标题（#667、#671）。
- 技能演进支持有边界的辅助文件，记忆空间增加可选 3D 概览，默认保留 2D 视图（#668、#669）。
- 技能评审展示现有的 64 KiB 写入上限，超限草稿可按实际大小重试，手工保存也会给出可操作的提示（#677）。
- 补充 Hindsight bank 独立写入说明与验证（#672）。

Updates Starter **0.5.48**, Memory Spaces **0.5.30** and Skills **0.5.15** only. The other 16 components keep their published versions. Existing data and configuration remain compatible. / 仅更新主包 **0.5.48**、Memory Spaces **0.5.30** 与 Skills **0.5.15**，其余 16 个组件保留原版本，现有数据与配置兼容。

Update through **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then fully restart DSH. Light context remains an enhancement alongside a main strategy. / 通过**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**升级后，完整重启 DSH；轻量上下文仍需与主策略搭配使用。

Verified Web installation and upgrade from 0.5.47 on DSH 0.2.2-rc.4. / 已在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.4 验证网页新装和从 0.5.47 升级。
